annotations.title: What do households spend on this category?

description: Use when the user is sizing a consumer market in dollars or comparing spend across groups: "how big is the US restaurant market by household income?", "which age group spends most on pets?". Returns the annual mean spend per consumer unit, the national total, and the split by income, age, household size or family type, with each group’s share of the dollars, from the BLS Consumer Expenditure Survey. National only. Refuses before you are charged if the groups do not add up to the total. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: one release (latest Consumer Expenditure Survey); segment: by (income, age, household size, family type), item. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For how many households match the profile, use run_audience_size.
